items.name: pluto-theme
items.title: Pluto theme
items.description: The Pluto Systems tokens for light and dark: colour, radius, spacing, type, motion, focus and the groove.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: font-geist
items.title: Geist
items.description: Geist, the body face, self-hosted through Fontsource.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: font-heading-ibm-plex-sans
items.title: IBM Plex Sans
items.description: IBM Plex Sans, the heading face, self-hosted through Fontsource.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: font-jetbrains-mono
items.title: JetBrains Mono
items.description: JetBrains Mono, the face for labels, code and data, self-hosted through Fontsource.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: The cn class-merging helper and the prop-type helpers that components import.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: four-dot
items.title: Four-dot mark
items.description: The Pluto Systems four-dot mark and the wordmark lockup, sized by the text around them.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: An action: the surface's one blue primary, a bordered secondary, ghost, destructive or link, at 48 or 32 px, with a busy state that keeps focus.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short inverted label that opens on hover and focus, closes on Escape, and repeats an icon button's name.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key, or a group of keys, set in the mono face on an inset.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state button that says whether it is pressed, inverted when it is.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: A row of toggles, one stop for the row, moved by the arrow keys, for one choice or several.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A raised surface with a header, content, footer and an action, whose title is a real heading.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: The groove between sections, decorative by default, or a plain vertical hairline.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A row of media, content and actions, plain or outlined, that can be one link.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A data table with a caption, header, selectable rows and a footer, scrolling inside itself when it must.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabbed panels as a pill strip on an inset or as underlined triggers, moved by the arrow keys.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A button that shows and hides a region, with its state in aria-expanded.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person's image or initials at the case radius, alone or in an overlapping group.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A small dialog anchored to its button, raised by the elevation shadow, that returns focus when it closes.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Headings that each open a section, divided by grooves, moved by the arrow keys.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A message in default, destructive, success or caution, whose role matches how urgent it is.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: A modal confirm on the scrim that traps focus, starts on Cancel and closes on Escape.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small mono label that names a state in words, outlined in its state colour.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: An empty state: an icon tile, a heading, a sentence and the next action.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A static, hidden placeholder on an inset where content is loading.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A turning icon for the one control that is busy, decorative by default or announced with a label.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: status
items.title: Status
items.description: An empty polite live region, present from the first render, whose text the app sets.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: error-summary
items.title: Error summary
items.description: The box a failed submit puts at the top of a form: a heading, the form's message and a link to each invalid field, focused when it appears.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A form label in sentence case, dimmed with its disabled control.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A label, control, description and error, wired to the control by id, aria-describedby and aria-invalid.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A 48 px text input on the raised ground with a visible border and a red one when invalid.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text input that grows with its text where the browser can.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input group
items.description: An input or textarea with text or button addons, one focus ring around the group, and a password toggle.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native select
items.description: The browser's own select, styled as an input, with a caret.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A 24 px checkbox that tells checked and mixed by shape as well as colour.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: Round radios in a group with one stop, moved and chosen by the arrow keys.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on and off setting: a blue track with a thumb that moves to the end.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A six-digit code in 48 px cells over one real input that accepts a pasted code.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: Code, output or a diff on the muted inset, highlighted from the code tokens, with line numbers, a copy button and a header divided by the groove.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: code-editor
items.title: Code editor
items.description: A CodeMirror 6 editor themed from the tokens, with line numbers and Python, that prerenders as plain code and leaves Tab unbound.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: highlighter
items.title: Highlighter
items.description: Shiki with the JavaScript engine and a theme whose every colour is a code token, for the server or the browser.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: use-highlighted-code
items.title: Use highlighted code
items.description: A hook that highlights a changing string line by line as it grows.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: A figure for layerchart with a name and a table of its data, series coloured by token classes, and a tooltip on the elevation shadow.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A measurement within a known range, as the native meter on the muted track with a primary fill, its numbers written beside it.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: A page's opening: an optional eyebrow, the one heading, a sentence, one call to action, and a feature grid divided by grooves.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: sign-in
items.title: Sign in
items.description: Email and password in one step, with an error summary that takes focus, a password you can show, and a button that goes busy.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: sign-up
items.title: Sign up
items.description: Email and a password with its rules written first, then a six-digit code on its own step, with resend.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: page-states
items.title: Page states
items.description: Empty, loading, error and not found as one family, with an error page for SvelteKit's error route.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>

items.name: settings
items.title: Settings
items.description: One column of sections divided by grooves, saved by one button, with an inline Saved message and a confirmed delete.
items.author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>
